text_block_list.text:
I beat you, you beat me not! I beat you,
you beat
me not!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп bests Тосэн Джордан with the
haughty
triumph of a child on the
playground! She also
gets a new clue, so
that's nice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
They promise to have a rematch on a big
stage
next time. Meanwhile, the
organizer of the search
for Eden and the
clues remains unknown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Fans congratulate Голд Шипп on her
second
consecutive victory at the
Takarazuka Kinen. I
can't be happier
about the monumental
achievement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп is proud of herself, but it
seems my
praise isn't enough, so she
demands to be
properly lauded. It's
kinda cute!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп is now ablaze. If she gets even
hotter
next year, she could very well
char the starting
gate beyond
recognition. Please don't!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп is over the moon. She buys
red and
white bean buns to celebrate,
but only gives me
the doughy parts...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
